Fellow inmates, there are exciting changes in the works here at SBBH that will be placed in effect sometime in the next 24-48 hours. Due to the evolving nature of Voat and the site's financial situation, we've been asked to help improve the optics of the site in general. External funding isn't as likely to embrace a site as classically liberal as Voat without some increased self-policing. So the first big change for SBBH will involve us going private to ensure that the offensive posts that make up the bulk of this subverse don't infect the rest of the site. This will, of course, remove us from the /v/all listings, so as a side effect, we will lose visibility and hemorrhage our user base as we'll be cut off from new users. In a way, though, this is a blessing in disguise.

Once we've segregated our particular style of humor and unique je ne sais quoi from the site at large, our next step will be the more difficult task. Seeing as we would like to return to the /v/all listings eventually, we will next transition to accepting submissions only from authorized users. There will be an intense vetting process to ensure that the most objectionable "humor" and extremist viewpoints aren't given any airtime here. We don't want to be held accountable for someone else's mental deficiencies and shortcomings, after all. Once we've combed through our current user base and vetted our most reliable submitters, we will be able to begin testing phase three of new course of action.

The third and final phase of our program involves real name registration and photograph avatars for SBBH submitters and commenters. This is the trickiest part, because it requires us to actually alter the backend of the sub a bit more than Voat ever intended for individual subs. We will begin requiring ISP issued email addresses, real names, and photographs of all SBBH users to help ensure proper behavior and decorum here on the sub. After all, what better way to scrub the horrors of the internet clean than with a bit of antiseptic sunlight in the form of attaching a name and face to every comment here? It will take us a few months to get all of the kinks ironed out of this, so the final solution may not be put into place for some time. Those of you who do not pass the vetting process may find yourselves without the witty repartee of SBBH for several months, but in the end, it will all be worth it!

@mick, the other mods, and I all thank you for your time and patience with us during this ambitious effort to help improve the quality of SBBH and Voat. Thank you, and have a happy new year.
